text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Buonjoooorno! On this wonderful morning, 
my Trainer is shining bright, too!
choice_data_list: Full of energy this morning, aren't you?

You're full of energy this morning, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Last night's sleep was truly molto 
bene! What's more—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A field of flowers surrounded by dogwoods, 
and an elegant session taking place right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A soul-cleansing moment that felt like a 
dream, and truly was one! Ah, elegante!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Today, whether in training or in a race, I 
feel like I can perform a most grazioso 
melodia!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth had pleasant dreams and 
seemed to have thoroughly refreshed 
herself.
